use std::panic::{catch_unwind, panic_any};
unsafe extern "C-unwind" {
    fn cpp_forward(callback: extern "C-unwind" fn(), swallow: i32) -> i32;
    fn cpp_throw();
}
struct Frame(&'static str);
impl Drop for Frame {
    fn drop(&mut self) { eprintln!("event {} {}", self.0, std::thread::panicking()); }
}
struct Payload;
impl Drop for Payload {
    fn drop(&mut self) { eprintln!("event payload {}", std::thread::panicking()); }
}
extern "C-unwind" fn raise() {
    let _guard = Frame("callback");
    panic_any(Payload);
}
fn main() {
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|_| {}));
    match std::env::args().nth(1).as_deref() {
        Some("rethrow") => {
            let error = catch_unwind(|| unsafe { cpp_forward(raise, 0) }).unwrap_err();
            assert!(error.is::<Payload>());
            assert!(!std::thread::panicking());
            drop(error);
            println!("rethrow passed");
        }
        Some("swallow") => {
            let value = unsafe { cpp_forward(raise, 1) };
            println!("swallow returned {value}");
        }
        Some("foreign") => {
            let _ = catch_unwind(|| {
                let _guard = Frame("foreign frame");
                unsafe { cpp_throw(); }
            });
            println!("foreign catch returned");
        }
        _ => panic!("expected a test case"),
    }
}
